shots.manualNote: AddToCalendarView calls EKEventStore.requestWriteOnlyAccessToEvents(), which shows iOS's one-time 'Would like to add to your Calendar' system consent alert over the New Event screen. Confirmed by direct testing that `xcrun simctl privacy <device> grant calendar <bundle-id>` (and even `grant all`) does NOT pre-answer it in this Xcode/simulator runtime, and it reappears on every relaunch until a human taps a button — there is no simctl flag for the write-only-Calendar tier. Fix: boot the target simulator once, launch ChqCalendar, trigger Add to Calendar (e.g. relaunch with -uitest-show-add-to-calendar), and tap 'Allow' by hand. That answer persists in the simulator's TCC state, so it is a one-time bootstrap per simulator instance, not a per-run manual step — after it's answered once, capture-screenshots.sh captures this shot automatically like the rest.
